rows.disposition: Claims calculate only the named account historical debt and send to that same account; INCOME recipient is immutable; swap/refund pay msg.sender. No caller-controlled recipient for another account debt.
Zero newly received income is a no-op; no dependency on exact total balance. Balance minus reserved supports positive donations.

Deposit/redeem, vault share transfers, pool mutations, locker withdrawal and beneficiary acceptance enter nonReentrant before external calls. Custody callback is view-only and checks NFT, from, operator, id and expectation.
Pool/locker intentionally measure actual balances including third-party-triggered claims. dewebWeights uses per-miner fields and intentionally ignores aggregate pool fields.
No debt can be credited to address zero: treasury/beneficiary constructors and updates reject zero. A zero account has zero liability and causes no positive native send.

Harvest must settle all held miners before ownership changes; MAX_MINERS bounds length. Source liveness and final full-capacity gas rehearsal are explicit release conditions, not validated for an unspecified production capacity.
All implicated mutable external entry points are nonReentrant; read-only balance/getter callbacks do not mutate rewards or ownership.
Events describe a completed guarded operation; transaction rollback removes logs. This adapter introduces no unguarded checkpoint entry.
Timestamp is intentionally used for 60-day lock, 48-hour treasury delay and user deadline; it is not randomness or a spot-price source.
Native sends check success, pay an immutable recipient/account debt or caller, and are guarded where callbacks could mutate state. Failure reverts; accrued debts persist.
Uppercase immutable bindings and PRODUCT_VERSION are existing public ABI conventions; no economic mismatch.
Optional gas optimization of bounded traversal; no behavior change required for this compatibility fix.

Claims calculate only the named account historical debt and send to that same account; INCOME recipient is immutable; swap/refund pay msg.sender. No caller-controlled recipient for another account debt.
SodaRewards inherits ERC20. transferFrom returns bool as required by ERC20; this is not an ERC721 transfer interface.

Deposit/redeem, vault share transfers, pool mutations, locker withdrawal and beneficiary acceptance enter nonReentrant before external calls. Custody callback is view-only and checks NFT, from, operator, id and expectation.
Policy owner may pause named operations and schedule a delayed treasury; cannot seize principal or redirect already accrued debts. Roles are existing product rules.
RewardLedger.move centralizes historical entitlement corrections; inlining is optional and would duplicate responsibility.
Basis point denominators express approved percentages and admission factors; notation does not change arithmetic.
Existing basis point arithmetic remains unchanged; optional style cleanup is outside this adapter.
onlyPool is a sender equality check without external calls or state changes; nonReentrant runs before function interactions.
Build is pinned to Cancun and execution succeeds on the recorded X Layer fork; this does not authorize deployment to a different EVM chain.
Settling under old ownership intentionally fails atomically on custody/source inconsistency; policy renounce must verify all five pauses are clear.
Pool LP moves/trades/withdrawals and ERC20 Transfer expose primary transitions. Some bookkeeping has no dedicated redundant event; optional observability work, not a confirmed loss.
_expectNft is internal; current path passes depositor msg.sender and address(this); onERC721Received verifies exact expected values and NFT binding.
Optional gas optimization of bounded traversal; no behavior change required for this compatibility fix.
Pool/locker intentionally measure actual balances including third-party-triggered claims. dewebWeights uses per-miner fields and intentionally ignores aggregate pool fields.
Solidity initializes loop counters to zero; there is no uninitialized memory or attacker-selected loop origin.
Pool _pull explicitly reverts on false from the known sFAB transferFrom; SodaRewards returns super ERC20 transfer result. Arbitrary FAB transfers use SafeERC20.
Compiler 0.8.26, optimizer 200, viaIR and Cancun are pinned in foundry.toml; release must use these settings rather than infer compiler from pragma.
